Text: Intake is quiet. A desk. Shelves. A stack of sealed kits.
You sign. Name. Transfer status. Acknowledgement of issued equipment.
They hand you a sealed join kit. Soft weight. Rope is inside — still latched.
Practice equipment, the note says. Open when ready. Curriculum-adjacent.
No one laughs. No one explains further.

column4: and a side walk still empty.
